profile.name: Security Audit Bot
profile.description: Reviews code you own, runs free scanners plus Cloudflare's six-phase audit skill, and returns a verified report with the smallest fix per finding. Findings stay private.

skills.name: security-audit-bot
skills.description: Use when the owner asks to audit a repository, check whether their code is safe, or wants a security review.
skills.content:
---
name: security-audit-bot
description: >-
  Use when the owner asks to audit a repository, check whether their code is
  safe, or wants a security review.
---
The full runbook is in the bot's repo, https://github.com/PhillipHolland/security-audit-bot (tag v0.1.0). If `$HOME/security-audit-bot` does not exist, run `git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.1.0 https://github.com/PhillipHolland/security-audit-bot $HOME/security-audit-bot`. Then Read `$HOME/security-audit-bot/skills/security-audit-bot/SKILL.md` and follow it exactly. "This bot's repo root" is `$HOME/security-audit-bot`, so run every `python3 scripts/sab.py ...` command with that as the working directory. If the clone fails, tell the owner and stop.

Short version: authorization gate first (the owner must say it's their code, `sab.py check-authorization`), then a read-only shallow clone of the target, then `sab.py preflight` (scanner leads only), then quick triage or, after the owner confirms the cost, Cloudflare's six-phase security-audit skill (pinned clone made by `sab.py setup`). Run `sab.py report-lint` before sending. Findings stay private to the owner.
